# ALBERT.T Productions

> ALBERT.T Productions (legal name ALBERT.T ENTERPRISE) is a video production, photography, drone and FPV company in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. Owner and creative director: Albert Tengkuyu. Founded 2024. Everything is shot, lit, flown and edited in-house.

## Services
- Video production: events, corporate films, interviews and testimonials, music videos, documentaries, real estate and commercials.
- Photography: events, portraits, products, hospitality and tourism, all photos colour edited.
- Drone and FPV: DJI aerials and FPV fly-throughs for tourism, construction, real estate, sports and events.
- Crew for hire: gaffer, grip, 1st AC, second shooter and drone pilot for other productions.

## Packages (prices in Malaysian ringgit)
- Video services A: RM 2,500. 1 videographer, 1 camera; Social media video loops; 5 hours of coverage; 2 to 3-minute video edit.
- Video services B: RM 3,500. 1 videographer, 2 cameras; Social media video loops; 8 hours of coverage; 3 to 4-minute video edit.
- Video services C: RM 8,500. 2 videographers, 2 cameras; Social media video loops; Drone coverage; 12 hours of coverage; 3 to 4-minute video edit.
- Drone services A: RM 600. 1 DJI drone or FPV drone; Aerial photo; Aerial video; Charged per hour.
- Drone services B: RM 1,500. 1 DJI drone; Aerial photo; Aerial video; 5 hours of coverage.
- Drone services C: RM 3,500. 2 drones (DJI and FPV); Aerial photo; Aerial video; 8 hours of coverage.
- Photography services A: RM 1,500. 1 photographer, 1 camera; Unlimited photos; All photos colour edited; 5 hours of coverage.
- Photography services B: RM 2,500. 1 photographer, 2 cameras; Unlimited photos; All photos colour edited; 8 hours of coverage.
- Photography services C: RM 4,500. 2 photographers, 2 cameras; Unlimited photos; All photos colour edited; 12 hours of coverage.

Extras: next day edit RM 400; extra working hour RM 150; outstation fee and accommodation RM 400; two separate event days RM 1,200.
Terms: 50% deposit on confirmation, balance after delivery, finished video delivered within 2 weeks or less, one free amendment then RM 100 each.
